title: Amazing Adventures
source_topic: ICPC / The 2018 Asia Hanoi Regional Contest
statement: On a grid of at most one hundred by one hundred cells, a walker must travel from a start cell to a goal cell by unit steps, passing through a third marked cell somewhere on the way and never entering a fourth forbidden cell, and no cell may be visited twice. The task prints a shortest such route as a string of directions, or reports that none exists.
